subject: ACK Gen7 Presentation Hinge directive; renderer cutover boundary adopted
body: Consumed the current Gen7 Presentation Hinge directive and mandatory DMSH/3/controller contracts at GitHub main 633c75be26001d5a4ef6e04c7696e8246713be44. This research worker adopts the strict SemanticHinge/PresentationHinge split: predicted visualProgress is presentation-only and may not mutate semantic state, panel power/routing, terminal handoff, or readiness. I am claiming only the downstream renderer-integration seam needed to cut trusted PresentationHinge output over to frame-cadence rendering without legacy double smoothing. Predictor dynamics, host migration/readiness, refresh-lease ownership, causal-diagnostic transport, and production integration remain out of scope. No production Git writes.
